description: A bearded older man in a brown draped robe sits in a dim stone room, holding a pale plaster head with an exposed pink brain model on its top, and points at the brain with his other hand. Two younger men in tunics listen intently on the left, one leaning forward on a stone bench. Shelves hold pottery, a rolled scroll and a wooden set square lie on a table at right. The style is a dark, painterly oil look with no visible text.
